title: Overlord: Ple Ple Pleiades 3
justification: AniList 103209 (ONA, 13 episode(s) from 2018-07-10) is AniDB 14008's special(s) S1-S13, aired 2018-07-10 to 2018-10-02. AniList's PARENT relation names the parent entry, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 14008. The parent's row start 1 end 13 offset 28 puts S1-S13 on TVDB 0x29-0x41.
